newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Barre, Vt..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Barre, Vt..

text.p: The Treasurer will receive sealed bids at his office in the City of Barre, Vermont, until ten thirty o'clock in the forenoon (10:30 a.m. ) on
for the purchase of all but no part of the Two Million One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,100,000) sewer system

improvement bond of the City of Barre, dated as of February 14 ,1997, principal and interest at the accepted rate payable in sixty (60) consecutive semi-annual installments commencing August 14, 1997 through February 14, 2027. Bids will be submitted only in the face amount of the bond without discount or premium, which bond shall bear interest at a rate not to exceed 4.50% per annum. Right is reserved to reject any or all bids. Interested persons are advised that the City has not prepared nor disseminated an official statement, offering memorandum or other disclosure materials with respect to the issuance and sale of the bond. The City has not applied for nor received a credit rating or any form of credit
enhancement with respect to the issuance and sale of the bond, nor has it engaged an underwriter or financial advisor.
